nav.choose_channel_desc: Library, likes and playlists will use this channel. You can switch again later.
nav.sign_in_hint: Sign in with your Google account to reach your YouTube Music library and playlists.
nav.remove_account_desc: {name} is only removed from this list. The Google account itself is not affected, and you can sign in with it again whenever you like.

player.queue_ends: The queue ends after this song.

home.shortcuts_desc: Whatever you reach for most, one click from home. Drag any card here, or pick from your library.
home.feed_empty: Your home feed came back empty this time.
home.signed_out_hint: Sign in and home fills up with mixes and playlists built from what you listen to.
home.edit_home_desc: Changes show up on the page as you make them.
home.card_size_desc: How big albums, playlists and artists are on the shelves.
home.mood_chips_desc: The row of chips above the feed that narrows it to one mood or genre.
home.artwork_backdrop_desc: Tint the header with the cover of whatever is playing.
home.sections_hint: Drag a section to move it, or focus its handle and use the arrow keys. Hidden sections keep their place.
home.show_new_desc: YouTube adds and renames shelves over time. Turned off, they arrive hidden and wait here until you switch them on.
home.all_hidden: Everything on home is switched off.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Everything you've played on YouTube Music, newest first.
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Anything you play while signed in shows up on this page.
history.signed_out: Sign in to see your YouTube Music listening history.

library.title: Library
library.sync_idle_tooltip: Add the {count} saved on this device to your YouTube Music library
library.no_playlists_hint: No playlists yet. Save one from its page, or create one in your Library.
library.collab_tooltip: Others can add to this playlist
library.delete_playlist_desc: “{title}” will be deleted from your YouTube Music account. This can’t be undone.
library.delete_playlist_desc_local: “{title}” will be deleted from this device. This can’t be undone.
library.every_song_saved: Every song you’ve saved, in one list
library.every_upload: Every track you’ve uploaded to YouTube Music
library.no_uploads: Nothing uploaded yet. Songs you upload at music.youtube.com show up here.
library.no_upload_albums: No uploaded albums yet. Albums you upload at music.youtube.com show up here.
library.uploads_signed_out: Sign in to see the music you’ve uploaded to YouTube Music.
library.songs_signed_out: Sign in to see the songs saved in your YouTube Music library. Music on this machine is in the Local tab.
library.no_library_songs: No songs in your library yet. Hit the ⋯ on a song and save it, or like it, and it lands here.
library.empty_signed_out: Nothing saved yet. Open a playlist or album and hit Save to library, or sign in for the one on your account.
library.no_saved_playlists: No playlists yet. Open one and hit Save to library to keep it here.
library.no_saved_albums: No saved albums yet. Open an album and hit Save to library.
library.no_saved_artists: No artists yet. Save one from its page to keep it here.
library.no_artists: No artists yet. They show up once you save their songs or albums.
library.no_subscriptions: No subscriptions yet. Subscribe to an artist from their page to keep them here.
library.on_repeat_subtitle: {count} songs you've played most this month
library.on_this_device_tooltip: Saved on this computer, not on a YouTube Music account
library.empty_playlist_hint: Pick Save to playlist from any song’s ⋯ menu to add it here.

local.folders_hint: Music in these folders plays without an internet connection.
local.no_folders: No folders yet. Add the one your music sits in and it shows up here.
local.nothing_playable: Nothing playable found in those folders yet. Looking for mp3, flac, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, wav, wma, aiff, ape, wv and mka files.

general.autostart_hint: Automatically start Limusic when your system boots.
general.close_to_tray_hint: Keep Limusic running in the background when closing the window.
general.track_notifications_hint: Show a notification when a new song starts while Limusic is in the background.
general.start_minimized_hint: When Limusic starts with your system, it stays in the tray until you open it. Opening it yourself always shows the window.
general.system_titlebar_hint: Let your desktop draw the window frame and its buttons. Limusic keeps its own toolbar below it.
general.discord_rpc_hint: Show the currently playing song on your Discord profile.
general.update_banner_hint: Show a banner when a new version of Limusic is available.
general.proxy_hint: Route all network requests through a custom proxy server.
general.stream_clients_hint: Turn a client off to skip it when resolving streams. Overridden by the {var} env var.

themes.font_placeholder: Font installed on this computer, e.g. Inter
themes.font_not_installed: Not installed — install the font, then reopen settings.
themes.tint_palette_hint: Only shades the default palette, {theme} brings its own colors.
themes.tint_hint: Shades the greys: surfaces, borders and secondary text.
themes.roundness_hint: Corner radius of cards, buttons and artwork.
themes.zoom_hint: Scales everything in the window. The zoom shortcuts change it too, and it is remembered between launches.
themes.load_font_file_hint: Load a .ttf, .otf or .woff from anywhere on this computer. It joins both dropdowns above.
themes.open_player: Open the player when you press play
themes.open_player_hint: On, playing a song, album or playlist brings up the full player view. Off, it starts playing and leaves you on the page you were browsing.
themes.tabbed_player: Queue and lyrics in the player view
themes.tabbed_player_hint: On, the player view carries them as tabs and the bar's two buttons switch between them. Off, those buttons only ever open the side panels, which stay open over the player view so you can see both at once.
themes.stage_player_hint: The song's title, artist and album under the artwork, queue and lyrics in a full-height column, and the view lit by the cover's colors. Off keeps the original layout.
themes.artwork_background_hint: Tint the player view with the playing track's cover, blurred. Off leaves it plain.
themes.artwork_accent_hint: Recolor the app from the playing track's cover: accent, surfaces and borders, fading between tracks. Off keeps the selected theme's own colors.
themes.reset_theme_hint: Drop the color, roundness and font overrides. Keeps the preset.
themes.app_icon_hint: A PNG replaces the icon in the tray, this window and Alt-Tab. Shortcuts, the file manager and the Windows taskbar button keep the installed one.
themes.mode_hint: System follows your computer's setting and switches with it.
themes.accent_hint: Buttons, the progress bar and anything selected.
themes.accent_artwork_note: While a song plays, the accent comes from its cover. Turn off Adapt colors to artwork to see this one.
themes.preview_hint: Sliders and the color picker show here as you drag, and the app follows when you let go.

playback.normalize_volume_hint: Even out how loud tracks play, so a quiet master is not buried by the one after it. Turn it off to hear every track exactly as it was mastered.
playback.autoplay_hint: Continuously play recommended tracks when the queue finishes.
playback.crossfade_hint: Fade the end of each track into the start of the next one. Runs a second audio decoder while tracks overlap, so it uses a little more memory.
playback.crossfade_lt_paused: Paused while you are in a Listen Together room: an overlap of two tracks cannot be kept in sync with everyone else.
playback.crossfade_duration_hint: How long the overlap lasts. Short tracks fade for less, so a fade never starts before the one before it has finished.
playback.prevent_duplicates_hint: Avoid adding songs that are already in the current queue.
playback.sticky_shuffle_hint: Leave off and shuffle applies only to what's playing: opening an album or playlist afterwards plays it in order.
playback.shuffle_whole_queue_hint: Shuffle mixes the songs you added with Add to queue in with the playlist. Leave off and they play after it, in the order you added them. Play next always plays next.
playback.play_history_hint: Remember recently played tracks for personalized recommendations.
playback.music_videos_hint: Show video stream when available instead of audio only.
playback.ambient_light_hint: The player view around a music video glows with the video's colours.
playback.ambient_light_gpu: Below about 1000 points in the PassMark video card benchmark, the player view may stutter while a music video plays.
playback.hide_videos_hint: Only show audio tracks and official releases in search results.
playback.blocked_artists_hint: Blocked artists are left out of radio, autoplay and recommendations. Playlists and albums you open still play everything in them.
playback.blocked_artists_empty: Nobody blocked yet. Use "Block artist" from a track's ⋯ menu.
playback.lastfm_primary_artist_hint: Send only the first credited artist to Last.fm, so your plays land on the real artist page. Names joined with "&" are kept whole.
playback.lastfm_primary_strict_hint: "Future & Metro Boomin" scrobbles as "Future". Duos with "&" in their name get shortened too.
playback.lyrics_sources_hint: Asked from the top down. Synced lyrics from any source beat plain text from one above it, and a source that's turned off is never asked.
playback.lyrics_sources_none: Every source is off, so no lyrics will be found.

hotkeys.title: Global Hotkeys
hotkeys.description: Control playback with customizable keyboard shortcuts even when Limusic is minimized or running in the background.
hotkeys.enable_hint: Global hotkeys are disabled. Turn them on to listen for shortcuts system-wide.
hotkeys.recording: Hold a modifier and press a key...
hotkeys.conflict: This shortcut is already assigned to "{action}"
hotkeys.failed_register: Could not register shortcut with the system (it may be in use by another app)
hotkeys.action_next_track_hint: Skip to the next song in the queue.
hotkeys.action_prev_track_hint: Return to the previous song in the queue.
hotkeys.action_mute_toggle_hint: Toggle between muted and previous volume.
hotkeys.action_seek_forward_hint: Jump forward 10 seconds in the track.
hotkeys.action_seek_backward_hint: Jump backward 10 seconds in the track.
hotkeys.action_toggle_shuffle_hint: Turn shuffle on or off for the queue.
hotkeys.action_toggle_repeat_hint: Cycle repeat mode: off, all, one.
hotkeys.action_show_app_hint: Bring the Limusic window to the foreground.

data.clear_cache_hint: Frees up disk space by clearing cached thumbnails and audio chunks.

about.description: A beautiful, fast, and lightweight desktop music player powered by Tauri and Svelte.
about.up_to_date: You are using the latest version.
about.update_packaged: This build was installed with a package manager, update it the same way.
about.rollback_available: This version is being rolled back to {version}, the last known-good release.
about.beta_hint: Get new versions a few days early, before everyone else. They are tested less. Turning this off keeps the version you have until the next regular release passes it.
about.diagnostics_hint: Your version, this system and the last part of the app log, ready to paste into a bug report. Cookies, tokens, signed links, file paths and IP addresses are removed first.
about.diagnostics_save_hint: Same text as a .txt, for dragging into the issue instead of pasting it.
about.report_issue_hint: Opens GitHub in your browser, with the version and system filled in.
about.kofi_hint: Limusic is free and stays free. Ko-fi is there if you feel like chipping in.

discord.enable_hint: Show the currently playing song on your Discord profile.
discord.off_notice: Rich Presence is off, so this is not on your profile. The preview still follows your changes.
discord.show_paused_hint: Keep the card up while the track is paused. Discord has no paused state, so the progress bar is dropped rather than left running.
discord.hide_details_hint: Say only that music is playing. No title, artist, album, artwork, progress bar or buttons leave your machine.
discord.status_line_hint: What Discord shows next to your name in the member list. The profile card below always shows the app name.
discord.app_name_hint: Replaces "Limusic" wherever the app name appears. Leave empty to keep it.
discord.line1_hint: The bold line, right under the header.
discord.cover_hint: Show the artwork next to the track.
discord.badge_hint: Mark the artwork with a small Limusic icon, the way Spotify and Apple Music cards do.
discord.line3_hint: The last line. Discord also uses it as the artwork’s hover text, so it needs the album art on.
discord.timestamps_hint: Show elapsed and remaining time under the track.
discord.links_hint: Turn a part of the card into a link. Discord opens it in YouTube Music, and the target follows what that part shows: a line with the album opens the album.
discord.buttons_hint: Discord shows at most two, and never on your own profile: only other people see them. A button whose target this track has no link for is skipped.
discord.preview_paused: Paused, so this is not on your profile right now. Turn on "Show when paused" to keep it up.

scrobbling.account_disconnected: Connect your Last.fm account to scrobble what you play.
scrobbling.account_connecting: Waiting for you to approve Limusic in your browser.
scrobbling.enable_hint: Turn off to stop scrobbling for a while without disconnecting your account.
scrobbling.now_playing_hint: Announce a track as it starts, so your profile shows it live.
scrobbling.percent_hint: How much of a track has to play. Last.fm's own rule is half. Raise it so songs you skip early don't count.
scrobbling.minutes_hint: Long tracks scrobble once this much has played, even before the percentage above. Last.fm uses 4 minutes. Tracks under 30 seconds never scrobble.
scrobbling.split_titles: Read the artist from video titles
scrobbling.split_titles_hint: Uploads credited to a channel often name the real artist in the title, as "Artist - Song". Scrobble those as that artist and song. Only applies to videos, never to songs.
scrobbling.rules_hint: Find and replace in what gets sent, applied to every track in order.
scrobbling.find_hint: A regular expression, ignoring case. Name a group (?<artist>…), (?<title>…) or (?<album>…) to move the match into that field.
scrobbling.import_hint: From a Pano Scrobbler or Web Scrobbler export
scrobbling.import_skipped: Left out, with no equivalent here: {count}.
scrobbling.import_unknown: That file isn't an export from Pano Scrobbler or Web Scrobbler.
scrobbling.edits_hint: Fixes for single tracks, from their next play on.
scrobbling.edits_empty: No edits yet. Add one from any song's menu.
scrobbling.edit_hint: Used every time this track plays. Leave a field empty to keep YouTube Music's.
scrobbling.status_disconnected: No scrobbling service is connected, so nothing is sent.
scrobbling.status_skip_edit: Your edit turns this track off.
scrobbling.status_incomplete: Nothing is sent: no title or artist is left.
scrobbling.lb_disconnected: Connect your ListenBrainz account to send it what you play.
scrobbling.lb_token_hint: Paste your user token here. You can copy it from your ListenBrainz settings page.
scrobbling.lb_problem_email: Verify your MetaBrainz email so ListenBrainz accepts your listens.
scrobbling.lb_problem_rejected: ListenBrainz no longer accepts this token. Connect again with a new one.

edit_playlist.new_desc: Create a new playlist to organize your songs.
edit_playlist.public_on: Anyone can find this playlist on YouTube Music.
edit_playlist.public_off: Only you can see this playlist.
edit_playlist.artwork_note: Artwork applies here at once and uploads to YouTube Music in the background. Square JPEG or PNG works best.
edit_playlist.local_artwork_note: Artwork stays on this computer. Square JPEG or PNG works best.

share.title: Share
share.public_link_on: Anyone with the link can open it.
share.public_link_off: Turn on to make the link work for everyone.
share.private_note: This playlist is private. Anyone you send the link to will get an error.

shortcuts.reopen_hint: {key} brings this back at any time.
shortcuts.toggle_now_playing: Show or hide the now-playing view

tempo_pitch.title: Tempo & Pitch Controls
tempo_pitch.desc: Applies to everything you play, until you change it back or restart the app.

link.title: Open link

link.invalid_link: That is not a YouTube Music or Spotify link

listen_together.title: Listen Together
listen_together.waiting_for_host: Waiting for the host to let you in…
listen_together.invite_placeholder: Paste the code a friend sent you
listen_together.invite_hint: The code carries everything needed, nothing else to set up.
listen_together.sync_server_hint: Only worth changing if you run your own sync server.
listen_together.err_paste_code: Paste the invite code your friend sent
listen_together.subtitle: Play the same music, at the same moment, with anyone.
listen_together.host_blurb: You get a short code to share. Everyone who joins hears exactly what you play, in sync.
listen_together.share_hint: Send this to anyone you want to listen with.
listen_together.alone_hint: Nobody else yet. Share the code above to fill the room.

new_playlist.account_desc: On your account, wherever you sign in
new_playlist.device_desc: No account needed, it stays on this computer
new_playlist.device_only: It stays on this computer, no account needed. Sign in to make playlists on YouTube Music instead.
new_playlist.local_files: Songs from your computer can only go in a playlist on this device.

integrations.discord_tooltip_on: Discord presence on — click to turn off
integrations.discord_tooltip_off: Show what you play on Discord
integrations.lastfm_connecting: Connecting to Last.fm — click to cancel

a11y.sync_to_ytm: Sync {count} saved items to YouTube Music
a11y.pick_colour: Pick a colour from the screen

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.none_found: No lyrics found for this track.
lyrics.romanize_hint: Show how each line is pronounced, in Latin letters
lyrics.none_found_hint: Try another source, or search with a different title.
lyrics.sources_hint: Just for this song. The default order is in Settings.
lyrics.automatic_hint: The first match in your order
lyrics.off_hint: Turned off in Settings. Check it for this song anyway?
lyrics.timing_hint: Lyrics ahead of the singer? Move them later.
lyrics.translation_hint: Show the translation some sources add under each line

about.boidu: The Better Lyrics database. Word by word, for songs someone has looked up before.
about.lyricsplus: Apple Music lyrics, word by word, with Apple's own romanization.
about.lrclib: Open library of synced lyrics. The widest coverage.
about.youtube: YouTube Music's own lyrics, where they're licensed.
about.simpmusic: Community lyrics matched to the exact YouTube upload, intros included.
about.netease: Large Chinese catalogue. Adds Chinese translations under many songs.
about.qq: Chinese catalogue, strong on Mandopop and Cantopop.
about.kugou: Chinese catalogue, for the rarer tracks.

toasts.could_not_play: Could not play — try opening it instead
toasts.could_not_queue: Could not queue that — try opening it instead
toasts.could_not_add: Could not add that, try opening it instead
toasts.could_not_load_playlist: Could not load that playlist — try opening it instead
toasts.could_not_copy_link: Could not copy the link. Select it and press Ctrl+C.
toasts.folder_removed: Folder removed from your local library
toasts.synced_partial: Synced {synced} of {total}. {failed} failed, still saved here.
toasts.synced_none: Nothing synced. {failed} failed, still saved here.
toasts.partial_playlist_queued: Couldn't load all of this playlist, so only what loaded was queued.
toasts.partial_playlist_added: Couldn't load all of this playlist, so only what loaded was added.
toasts.sort_not_saved: Sorted, but couldn't save it to YouTube: {error}
toasts.already_in_selected: Everything is already in the selected playlists

import.title: Import from Spotify
import.experimental_tooltip: New and still being fine-tuned. If an import gets something wrong, please report it.
import.desc: Bring your playlists over. It all runs on this computer: Spotify is only asked for the playlist, YouTube Music only for the songs.
import.link_desc: Any public playlist or album. In Spotify, open its ⋯ menu, then Share, then Copy link.
import.data_desc: Everything, private playlists and Liked Songs included. Ask Spotify for your account data and it arrives by email, usually within a few days.
import.drop_hint: When the email arrives, drop the zip here. CSV files from Exportify, TuneMyMusic or Soundiiz work too.
import.truncated: Spotify only shared the first 100 songs of this playlist. To bring all of it, use your Spotify data.
import.keep_browsing_hint: You can close this, it keeps going. The sidebar shows how far along it is.
import.pace_hint: Limusic goes slowly on purpose, about one song every two seconds, so YouTube Music sees ordinary use.
import.waiting: Taking a break to stay well within YouTube Music’s limits. It carries on at {time}.
import.review_desc: {matched} of {total} songs matched. Every pick below is already filled in, so you can create right away or change any of them first.
import.paste_link_hint: Only on YouTube as a video? Paste its link.
import.many_lists: {count} playlists will be created, each with its Spotify name.
import.device_only: Signed out, the playlists are kept on this device.
import.failed_hint: Songs found so far are remembered, so trying again picks up where this left off.
import.cancelled_desc: Songs found so far are remembered, so a new import picks up where this one left off.
import.toast_review: Your Spotify import is ready. Open it from the sidebar to finish.
import.toast_done: Your Spotify playlists are in your library.
import.update_tooltip: Add what’s new in the Spotify playlist and take out what left it
import.update_none: Already up to date with Spotify
import.nudge_desc: Bring your playlists and Liked Songs over in a few clicks.

errors.not_spotify: That isn’t a Spotify playlist or album link.
errors.private: That playlist is private, so it can’t be imported from a link. Request your Spotify data below to bring it over.
errors.not_a_list: That links a song or an artist. Paste a playlist or an album.
errors.empty: There are no songs in that.
errors.unreadable: That file couldn’t be read. Use the zip Spotify emailed you, one of the JSON files inside it, or a CSV.
errors.csv_columns: That CSV has no column of song titles.
errors.spotify_changed: Spotify changed how it shares playlists. A Limusic update will fix this.
errors.not_found: Couldn’t find that on YouTube Music.
errors.cooldown: YouTube Music asked Limusic to slow down, so imports are paused until {time}. Everything found so far is saved.
